idea: Take profit earlier on FADE: full exit or partial at +0.5R to +1.5R, higher-low trail, reversal-bar exit, bigger locks (governor question after the 10-28 SOXS trade)

result: Every variant lost to the live rules: full exit at +1R PF 1.96 +21.5%, at +1.5R PF 2.80 +40.5%; sell 1/3 at +0.75R PF 3.57 +54.1%; higher-low trail from +1R PF 2.88 +42.7%; reversal-bar exit from +0.5R PF 4.04 +66.8%; lock +0.30R PF 4.10 +68.0%, +0.40R PF 3.35 +55.1%. The edge lives in the runners that reach 2R.

idea: Early tell for choppy FADE trades: 2 or more closes below entry in the first 30 minutes, then exit earlier (governor question)
method: tools/backtest/early_tell_rh.py, results/early_tell_rh.txt, all 90 Robinhood setups for the tell, the 63 account trades for the exits
result: The tell is real: 23 choppy trades averaged +0.14R and reached 2R 30% of the time, the other 67 averaged +1.24R and reached 2R 52%. But no exit treatment beat the base: best was sell half at +0.75R, PF 4.64 +83.9% against 4.81 +89.3%; a raised lock for them was a wash (at best PF 4.82). Now shadowed forward as ideas fade.chop.2red.*.

Walk-forward picks lost to live under all four rules (+11.9/+93.2/+16.4/+2.0 vs +140.7)
verdict: not adopted; offered as "push system 1" / "push system 2"; tuned picks do not transfer in walk-forward

idea: Rebuild systems 1-3 with TRAIN = 2022, 2024, 2026 and TEST = 2023, 2025: robust tune, most-consistent-months tune (each year alone), new systems re-chosen, parallel vs replacement

result: Live test 2023 -29.8, 2025 +18.3 (-16.9% compounded). System 1 pick -30.2, +15.9 (worse than live both years; score-to-test rank correlation +0.15). idea: Overnight leg sizing and risk: long signal or long + dip, 100/50/33/25% of cash, cost doubled, FADE at 100/50/0%
method: tools/backtest/overnight_size.py; baseline v5.2.51; train 2022/2024/2026, test 2023/2025; whole-period drawdown and A1.13 15% stop count
result: Long signal at 50%: +136.7, +36.8, +12.8, +113.0, +204.0 (average 2022-25 +74.8 vs +67.6), max DD 23.1 vs 25.4, 15% stop fires 2x vs 5x, worst night -4.1%, passes with cost doubled. Long + dip at 50%: average +84.7, 2026 below baseline, fails the test rule with cost doubled. Baseline book trips the 15% stop 5 times in the backtest
verdict: not adopted (A1.8); recommended form if the governor approves: long signal only at 50% of cash

idea: Universe check for the overnight leg: drop one of the six proxies, add one of 12 new ones
method: tools/backtest/overnight_universe.py; baseline v5.2.51 + overnight long at 50%; train 2022/2024/2026, test 2023/2025
result: No change passes. Five qualify on train (EEM, FXI, XLRE, XOP, XLU) and none beats the baseline in both test years. The overnight leg alone is positive on 10 of 12 new proxies (+0.18 to +0.62% a leg), so the effect is general, but one position a night chosen by volume gains nothing from more funds
verdict: ADOPTED: overnight leg on the six proxies (v5.2.52), governor instruction 2026-11-14; universe unchanged
